messages:
maria: kicking off shadow rollout of FP8 kernel for atlas-13b across L40S + H100. shadow_pct=2% starting now. quick smoke: cost looks good but we see top-1 token delta ~0.4-0.7% on our long-context eval (>4096). anyone seen similar?

cheng: can you paste the quick numbers/logs? is this numerical drift or a routing/tiling mismatch?

maria: short dump: 
```
config: {model: atlas-13b, kernels: fp8-enabled, hw: [l40s,h100], shadow_pct: 0.02}
sample_eval: prompt_len=8192, tokens=512, baseline_top1=0.876, fp8_top1=0.869, delta_top1=-0.007
logit_diffs_excerpt: [ {token:"the",base: -1.12,fp8: -1.28,delta:-0.16}, {token:"and",base:0.34,fp8:0.21,delta:-0.13} ]
observed: negative-logit tail heavier under fp8 on long contexts
```

samir: hmm. that smells like kv-cache tiling or handshake differences between L40S and H100 codepaths. we changed the handshake/tiling heuristic on L40S last week — could double-apply per-channel scaling in some flows.

leo: tagging @cheng: we also flipped the per-layer activation scaling opt last deploy for L40S (to reduce dynamic range blowup). if the shadow path uses a different post-processing chain that could explain systematic bias.

ops-bot: shadow-traffic: 2% -> ~2k req/min, routes: h100-1 lanes, l40s-3 lanes (replica skew observed: l40s handling ~65% of shadow).

cheng: I'm looking at histograms now. fp8 shows heavier negative tail on activation distributions for layers 36..52 when seq>4096 — consistent with saturation/rounding bias. can you run a canary with activation scaling disabled?

maria: started a targeted canary with fp8.activation_scaling=false on L40S at 1765567950. command used: 
```bash
rundep --canary --env=staging --model=atlas-13b --set "fp8.activation_scaling=false" --traffic=1%
```
also created GH#5123 with initial diffs and example prompts: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/5123

samir: also capture per-layer scale factors and quantization zero-points. past bug: per-layer scale reset for layers >48 when seq>4096 (edge-case in tiling). if that reappears we get correlated negative bias.

leo: proposed mitigation plan if canary confirms: 1) revert L40S tiling handshake patch, 2) re-run AWQ/GPTQ baselines to see whether INT8/GPTQ hold better under long prefixes, 3) run a slow rollout with per-layer telemetry enabled. action items: @cheng capture traces, @maria keep shadow on for 1h and post artifacts, @samir collect per-layer stats.

maria: ack. logging outputs to /mnt/evals/fp8-shadow/1765567890 and adding raw traces to GH#5123. will update in ~30m with canary vs shadow diffs. :thumbsup:
